meta.title: Request an ID Card or Declarations Page — Safe House Insurance
meta.desc: Request your insurance ID card or declarations page. Enter your policy number and tell us what you need. We send it to the phone and email already on your policy. Safe House Insurance, El Paso TX. Se habla espanol.
meta.ogTitle: Request an ID Card or Declarations Page
meta.ogDesc: Tell us what you need and we send it to the contacts already on your policy.

hero.h1: Need your ID card?Ask us here.
hero.lede:
Tell us your policy number and what you need. An agent sends it to the
        phone and email already on your policy — usually the same business day.

form.sub: Everything here stays in your browser until you press send.

pol.label: Policy number
pol.help: On your ID card, top left. Spaces and dashes don’t matter.

id.p:
The card you keep in the car and show
              to an officer. Proof the policy is active.

dec.p:
The full summary: vehicles,
              drivers, every coverage and limit, and the dates. Banks ask for this one.

forBank.label: Is the declarations page for a bank or lender?
forBank.help:
If a lender is asking for proof of coverage, we can send it
            straight to them as well as to you.

bmail.label: Where should we send it?
bmail.help:
The lender’s email or fax, if you have it. Leave it blank and
              we will send it to you to forward.

notes.label: Anything else we should know?
notes.ph: e.g. I only need the card for the truck, not both cars.

form.note:
This opens your email app with the details filled in. Nothing is sent
        until you press send there. Rather text it? Use the button on the next screen.

done.warnHead: Changed your phone number or email since you bought the policy?
done.warn: Then it will go to the old ones and you will not see it. Call 915-503-1207 or text 915-594-3777 and we will update the policy and resend it while you are on the line.
done.altText: Or send the same request by text

id.p1:
One small card per vehicle. It shows the company, the policy number, the dates the
          policy runs, and which car it covers. It is what you hand to an officer at a traffic
          stop and what a dealership wants before you drive off the lot.
id.p2: Texas and New Mexico both accept it on your phone. You do not need the paper one.

dec.p1: Usually called the dec page. It is the summary of the whole policy: every vehicle, every driver, every coverage with its limit and deductible, the premium, and the dates. Two or three pages, not a card.
dec.p2:
This is the one a lender, a leasing company or a landlord asks for, because it
          proves not just that you have insurance but that you have the specific coverage
          they require.

faq.q1: How fast can I get it?
faq.a1:
Same business day in almost every case, and within minutes if you call during
          office hours rather than filling in this form. Mon–Fri, 11am–5pm Mountain.
faq.q2: Why does it go to the contacts on my policy?
faq.a2:
Because a declarations page lists your vehicles, your drivers and your address. If
          we sent it to whatever address a form typed in, anyone with your policy number could
          collect it. Sending it where the policy already points is the check.
faq.q3: I do not have my policy number.
faq.a3:
Call or text and we will look it up from your name and date of birth. We hold the
          policy on our side, so it takes about a minute.
faq.q4: My bank keeps saying they never got it.
faq.a4: That is usually a reference number problem rather than a sending problem — lenders file by loan number, not by name. Send us the loan number and we will resend it referenced properly. Your bank can also request it directly: the lienholder page →
faq.q5: Can I get a card for just one car?
faq.a5:
Yes. Put it in the notes box. By default we send a card for every vehicle on the
          policy, which is what most people want.
faq.q6: Do I need the paper card in my glovebox?
faq.a6:
Not in Texas or New Mexico — a photo or the PDF on your phone is accepted. Keeping
          a paper copy anyway costs nothing and phones run out of battery.

more.payNote: Straight to your carrier’s payment page
more.claimNote: We will start it with you
more.reshop: See if you can pay less

err.pol: We need the policy number. It is on your ID card, top left — or call us and we will look it up.
err.name: Please give the first and last name on the policy, so we send the right one.
err.docs: Pick at least one document — an ID card, a declarations page, or both.
err.bank: Which bank or lender is asking for it? The name is enough.
